title: AI Engineer
summary: Builds production LLM-powered products (agents, RAG pipelines, evals, prompt and tool design) on top of foundation model APIs, rather than training or researching new models.

skills.name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
skills.question: Have you built a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline for an LLM application?

skills.name: LLM Provider APIs
skills.question: Have you integrated LLM provider APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, or Vertex AI) into a product?

skills.name: Python
skills.question: Is Python your primary language for building AI/LLM systems?

skills.name: Vector Databases
skills.question: Have you used a vector database (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, FAISS, Qdrant, or pgvector) for semantic search?

skills.name: Prompt Engineering
skills.question: Have you designed and iterated on prompts to improve production LLM output quality?

skills.name: LLM Evaluation Frameworks
skills.question: Have you built an evaluation harness to measure and regression-test LLM or agent output quality?

skills.name: Agent Frameworks & Orchestration
skills.question: Have you designed or built multi-step autonomous agents that plan and execute tasks?

skills.name: Function Calling / Tool Use
skills.question: Have you implemented function calling or tool-use orchestration for an LLM?

skills.name: Embeddings
skills.question: Have you generated or used embeddings for semantic search or clustering?

skills.name: LLM Observability & Tracing
skills.question: Have you instrumented an LLM or agent system with tracing and observability tooling?

skills.name: LangChain / LlamaIndex
skills.question: Have you built LLM applications using LangChain or LlamaIndex?

skills.name: Context Engineering
skills.question: Have you engineered context construction and context-window management for an LLM agent?

skills.name: PostgreSQL
skills.question: Have you used PostgreSQL (including pgvector) as a data store for an AI application?

skills.name: AWS
skills.question: Have you deployed AI/LLM workloads on AWS (Bedrock, Lambda, or ECS Fargate)?

skills.name: SQL
skills.question: Are you comfortable writing SQL to query and shape data for AI applications?

skills.name: REST API Design
skills.question: Have you designed REST APIs to serve an AI-powered feature to production users?

skills.name: AI Regression Testing
skills.question: Have you built golden-dataset regression tests to catch AI quality regressions before release?

skills.name: Git
skills.question: Do you use Git for version control in a team workflow?

skills.name: TypeScript
skills.question: Have you built LLM-powered application backends or tooling in TypeScript/Node.js?

skills.name: Model Fine-Tuning / Post-Training
skills.question: Have you fine-tuned or post-trained a model for a specific task?

skills.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
skills.question: Have you built or integrated tools using the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

skills.name: Model Routing / Multi-Model Orchestration
skills.question: Have you built logic to route requests across multiple LLM providers or models based on cost/quality/latency?

skills.name: Hugging Face / Transformers
skills.question: Have you used Hugging Face Transformers to load or serve models?

skills.name: Data Pipelines / ETL
skills.question: Have you built data ingestion pipelines to feed documents or structured data into an AI system?

skills.name: Docker
skills.question: Have you containerized an AI service with Docker for deployment?

skills.name: CI/CD Pipelines
skills.question: Have you built CI/CD pipelines to test and deploy an AI-powered feature?

skills.name: RLHF / Reward Modeling
skills.question: Have you worked with RLHF or reward-model-based feedback loops to improve model behavior?

skills.name: Distributed Compute (Ray)
skills.question: Have you used a distributed compute framework like Ray for batch inference or eval pipelines?

skills.name: Redis
skills.question: Have you used Redis for caching or session state in an AI application?

skills.name: MongoDB
skills.question: Have you used MongoDB as a data store for an AI-powered application?

skills.name: Kubernetes
skills.question: Have you deployed AI/LLM services on Kubernetes at scale?

skills.name: Data Privacy & Compliance (PII/PHI)
skills.question: Have you handled PII/PHI data compliance requirements (e.g. HIPAA) in an AI system?
